notes: Only atom allowed raw <input>/<select>/<textarea>. Author free-text lives in labelForm (primary) + contentForm* sub-content (Placeholder, Description, Error, Suggestion). Per-option content: contentOption, contentOptionSimple, contentOptionDescription. Card-select renders options as pictogram cards — child media atom owns its props. Assistive render applied via [data-render='assistive'] gate (assistive-gate.css).

_rules.action: value accepts string[] only for card-select with maxSelections > 1. All other types require string.
options[] is required when type='select' or 'card-select'.
radioValue applies only to type='radio'; ignored on other types.
checked applies only to checkbox | radio | toggle.

_rules.condition: (min !== undefined || max !== undefined || step !== undefined) && type !== 'number'
_rules.action: min, max, step apply only to type='number'.

_rules.condition: min !== undefined && max !== undefined && min >= max
_rules.action: min must be strictly less than max.
pattern (HTML5 regex) applies only to text-like types: text, email, tel, url, search, password.
minLength, maxLength apply only to text-based types and textarea.

_rules.condition: minLength !== undefined && maxLength !== undefined && minLength > maxLength
((maxSelections !== undefined && maxSelections > 1) || cardSize !== undefined || cardColumns !== undefined) && type !== 'card-select'
_rules.action: maxSelections, cardSize, cardColumns apply only to type='card-select'.
inputMode (mobile keyboard hint) has no effect on checkbox/radio/toggle/select/card-select.
autocomplete applies to native inputs only; ignored on select/card-select.
Per-option aacPhrase applies only inside card-select options[].
Per-option media applies only inside card-select options[].
Per-option contentOptionSimple applies only inside card-select options[].
Per-option contentOptionDescription applies only inside card-select options[].

Each card option with media at semanticRole='content-symbol' (default) requires alt (Image) or labelIcon (Icon) — the label is composed into the card's accessible name as ', with <icon|image> <label>'. Set semanticRole='decorative' if the media is purely visual reinforcement.

labelForm._note: Primary label — must visually describe the field's purpose.

contentFormDescription._note: Helper text below the label. Linked via aria-describedby.

hideLabel._note: Visually hides label (sr-only); accessible name must still match visible text upstream.

value._note: card-select multi-select (maxSelections > 1) accepts string[] of pre-ticked values; everything else is string.

radioValue._note: Submission value for radio (separate from group 'value' used for selection comparison).

rows._note: textarea only. <2 rows should be type='text'.

inputMode._note: Smart default per type — override only if needed.

maxSelections._note: card-select: 1 = single (radio behaviour); >1 = multi (checkbox + limit enforcement).

_selectOptionShape._description: Shape of each entry in options[] when type='select' or 'card-select'.

contentOptionSimple._note: Simplified text for low-cognitive-level rendering. Falls back to contentOption.

contentOptionDescription._note: Helper text below the option (card-select only).

display._note: card-select only. Default: matches input type.

aacPhrase._note: FORWARD-DECLARED — AAC pictogram resolver wiring deferred. No runtime effect today. card-select only. opt.media wins if both set.

media._description: Nested atom node — card-select only. Child atom owns its own props (size, weight, fit, src/alt, etc.); FormField only adds the layout class. semanticRole defaults to content-symbol — the icon/image reinforces the option meaning. Author may override to decorative for purely visual reinforcement (e.g. brand glyph).

semanticRole._note: content-symbol: label appended to card's accessible name as ', with <icon|image> <label>'. decorative: icon/image hidden from SR (and stripped in textonly).
